FFmpeg / FFprobe 9.0.1 — @TARGET@

These separately invoked command-line programs are FFmpeg GPL version 3 builds.
FFmpeg is copyright the FFmpeg developers; see COPYING.GPLv3 and the bundled
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt for the included components and their copyright notices.
The application does not claim ownership of these programs.

The corresponding source, dependency sources, patches and build instructions
are distributed beside this application download in:
  ffmpeg-source/@TARGET@/@SOURCE_ARCHIVE@
SOURCE-RELEASE.json records the exact binary archives and source file hashes.
BUILDING.md describes the corresponding build. The release download page must
link this source archive alongside the installer / ZIP, without a login or fee.

Built from FFmpeg 9.0.1 and x264 commit
b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55 using the included build instructions.
There are no additional third-party multimedia libraries linked into this build.
FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
x264 project: https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html

manifest.json hashes describe the binaries before application signing.
Application re-signing may change those bytes; the final application signature
and installer / ZIP checksum cover the distributed result.
